Name: Vassago's Emblem
Basic Side: When an air units wins combat, give the next air unit -1 power on their priority check
Condition: If 4 Unkengeister are in the exhaust zone at once: Transform Vassago
For AI notes: The Attack Power is NOT part of the base power but is added addtionally when the unit triggers it ability priority.
